author: Bobby Grayson
description: lean_total? returns true iff the message pattern is bare or every rendered message part is a plain identifier, and every rendered state part is a plain identifier (none/true/false excluded). patterns/2 now stores the rendered message parts in env[:__mparts__]. Rationale from the builder: in watchdog.ex 'handle_cast(:pong, {w, true})' has state part (some w) and literal true, so it is not total and a crash clause for .pong is needed; judging on the Elixir AST would misclassify pid-narrowed variables as total (missing a crash clause) or literal-free-but-narrowed ones as partial (emitting a Lean-redundant clause that changes existing Gen files). A bare message variable in a cast/call clause covers every tag (:all in covered).
title: Totality (lean_total?/2, plain?/1) is judged on the rendered Lean pattern parts (env[:__mparts__]/[:__sparts__]), not on Elixir patterns, because pid-narrowing renders a bare w at pid()|nil as (some w)
